title: Research construction: seven grid-preserving JP8 circuits save 104 primitives per orientation (no new kappa)
body:
Seven coefficients in the historical #626 JP8 scalar programs admit shorter single-scratch circuits than all four binary/NAF Horner variants from #837. The circuits interleave halvings and repeated source additions while retaining the original magnitude envelope, fractional grid and clearing boundary.

**Status: finite complex-supplier circuit construction; no new kappa.**

| Complete JP8 scalar projection | Accepted #696 | Replacement | Saved |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Forward | 200,380 | 200,276 | 104 |
| Backward / inverse-transpose | 200,396 | 200,292 | 104 |

Each orientation changes 44 macros. At those occurrences, the saving against the best of all four #837 variants is 88 real primitives. These are separate comparisons: the full #837 program is not composed here. All other macros retain #696. The additional 92 real source reads per orientation are explicitly included in the charged primitive bill; there are no added helpers, frame changes or recursive children.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.11+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/jp8-grid-bounded-synthesis/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_JP8_GRID_BOUNDED_SYNTHESIS coefficients=49 improved=7 extra_vs_four_horner=88,88 columns=716+9 kappa=unchanged`.

The prespecified search covers all 49 nonunit absolute JP8 coefficients with reduced numerator <=127 and denominator <=16. Each graph fixes the original numerator magnitude envelope and coefficient grid. An independently implemented Bellman/potential checker verifies all 3,703 vertices and 14,311 distinct directed edges, proving exact minima in this restricted single-scratch class. Seven words strictly beat all four Horner comparators; no general circuit-optimality or shift/add novelty claim is made.

Both complete scalar orientations pass exact primitive replay on 716 logical plus nine arbitrary private input columns, including restoration and clearing. All three traces retain exact scalar fractional denominator maxima 4 forward / 27 backward, unlike optimizations that only check endpoint identity. Eleven macro and four graph rejection controls pass. Nine package tests pass on CPython 3.14.7 and 3.11.15, including optimized minimal relocation, gzip repackaging, missing-pin/source/receipt/path corruption and output preservation. `make selected-record-check` and staged scope/whitespace checks pass.

Only `research/jp8-grid-bounded-synthesis/` is added. Base: `f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`. OS assignment seed33 selected the complex track and JP8 scope; no pinned sprint issue existed. Source and comparator heads, all input hashes, the complete search certificate, proof, receipt, overlap check and validation are included. The selected #799 frontier and `upstream/` are untouched.

Credit Sagar Thakrar's #696/#723, Gareth Davidson's #837 and #866, Chris Pagolu's #734, and the retained icekylinx / Jeremy Kothe / Chafik Boukhalfa / DreamingOfClouds / Rohan Arun / eumemic lineage. #734's graph covers bounded integer Horner transitions; this search admits interleaved halves and repeated reads. #811/#860 reuse work across macros, while this contribution retains every clearing boundary. No pending savings are added without composition.

Production integration, native frame/phase admission, refreshed global owner/invoice/assembly and full compiler precision remain separate obligations. Full repository/cold supplier suites, remote CI and Lean were not run. All inherited all-size/realization/hosting/precision/tape/analytic assumptions remain. Finite scalar checks are not a full multiplication theorem or a measured runtime improvement.

Prepared for **Philipp (@mightyOil)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate AI workers for graph verification, scalar replay and proof review. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0; predecessor source attribution is retained.
